preserved_behavior: Pure parser/filter only; no runtime patching or relocation application.
Empty and scalar flags 8, 16, 32, and 64 pass.
Flags 12, 21, and unknown values fail closed.
Malformed headers, lengths, bounds, tools, and architectures exit 2.
package_repository_adaptations: Adds explicit v1 8-byte record parsing and reports non-empty legacy v1 as a policy failure.
Adds checked UInt64 section-end and file-offset arithmetic.
Adds table_format to schema 1 without removing existing fields.
Promotes the five sealed real AA64 PE fixtures into .ci/fixtures.
Wires the same checker into fixed-binutils consumer links.
Keeps V2 exact nm symbol matching, unknown-flag 99 rejection, short-header rejection, and automatic real-fixture replay.
